fusions.name: Stinger Jab
fusions.desc: A jab of the beak that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your movement speed rises by 15% for 3 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Swarming Rush
fusions.desc: Drives the flock through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 10 damage to everything in it; your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles. Its damage rises 8% for each ally beside you, up to 32%.

fusions.name: Hatchling Cloud
fusions.desc: Calls up a swarm of chicks that fights for 15 seconds, pecking an enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage every second.

fusions.name: Tireless Foraging
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 6. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 5% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
